name: rankine_cycle_regenerative_extraction
title: Steam Rankine cycle with regenerative extraction
summary: 60 MW steam plant (70 bar, 500 C, 0.1 bar condenser) with a regenerative steam extraction at 25 bar to an open feedwater heater: steam and extraction flow rates, boiler power, cooling-water flow rate, plant thermal efficiency; state points as arrays for the diagrams.

origin.course: Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), repetition 7, exercise 3

verification.reference: EES stored solution of EES_ok/rankine2.EES (44 variables, 25 bar extraction run)
verification.notes: All 44 common variables agree within the default rtol=0.001 of compare_solution.py (0 differ); largest deviation 5.5e-4 on M_dot_steam_s (EES 7.2 vs CoolProp water properties). The 29 CoolSolve-only variables are the 28 diagram state-array elements plus P_2b (not stored by EES).

related_external: CoolSolve examples/rankine2.eescode (CSX-037): same EES origin, solved at 14 bar while its header announces 25 bar; stays in CoolSolve as a test case

history.action: added (task C-30: faithful import of EES_ok/rankine2.EES at the 25 bar stored solution; CSX-037 merged; DG-0107 triaged as duplicates)
